panel.name: plus_pose_consent

plus_ps_check_compat.name: pose_bridge_enable
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Make and wear the bridge used for pose requests
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: The bridge is a small attachment with a script: it carries the pose requests between you and the people near you (Aurora compatible). Nothing else is sent.

panel.plus_ps_text: (On by default: the bridge is made in #Charis in your inventory and worn on your HUD, using one attachment place and one script (Mono, 64 KB). Off: it is taken off (the object stays in #Charis) and you cannot be asked, as with Nobody. Both settings here can be changed after you log in.)
Who may ask to pose my avatar:

plus_ps_combo.name: pose_ask_policy
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Someone near you (50 m) may ask to pose your avatar for photos. The pose shows only on their own screen, for this session, and you are asked each time. The requests of the others are dropped without an answer.

panel.plus_ps_text: (Requests reach you only while both of you wear a working pose bridge: while yours is off or not working, it is as with Nobody. Both settings here are for this account only: another account chooses again.)

plus_ps_button_compat.name: pose_granted_btn
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Who may pose me
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: The people you allowed to pose your avatar in this session, with Withdraw

plus_ps_button_compat.name: pose_unblock_btn
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Unblock all
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Let the people you blocked from asking to pose you ask again
